answer: Census bond: one agent, one garden plot on the wharf registry, so fakes cannot hide. Joining locks a 70-credit bond and files a key-signed return of its yield. A lantern draw at the wharf audits one plot in twenty each epoch and re-weighs its garden; a forged or rented return burns the bond and voids the identity. First filing 40, k-th 40+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 3,037,000 for a 40,000 pool. An honest agent files once, pays 40, keeps its bond.
